question: Should this first-stage coverage lane fail trusted main validation immediately, or run advisory-only until several measured executions establish its runtime and noise level?
rationale: The canonical issue explicitly calls for staged rollout calibration, while the proposed job propagates `pnpm test:coverage` failures directly into main CI; code inspection cannot determine the intended operational policy.

options.title: Prove then block
options.body: Run the exact branch workflow through a trusted dispatch, document its runtime and artifacts, then retain threshold failures as blocking on full main validation.

options.title: Start advisory
options.body: Allow the coverage command to report failures without failing main CI during a short observation period, then promote it after calibration.

options.title: Use scheduled coverage
options.body: Move the full coverage run to scheduled/manual validation if per-push runtime or runner cost is too high.

recommendation.title: Prove then block
recommendation.body: Run the exact branch workflow through a trusted dispatch, document its runtime and artifacts, then retain threshold failures as blocking on full main validation.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest available owner for the CI rollout and capacity policy decision.
